stateInfo = dict(self.view.custom.stateInfo)
	stateId = stateInfo['stateId']
	stateCategoryId = stateInfo['stateCategoryId']
	assetGroupId = stateInfo['assetGroupId']
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	
	if stateInfo['assetGroupId'] is not None:
		try:
			int(stateInfo['assetGroupId'])
		except:
			 stateInfo['assetGroupId'] = system.kanoa.asset.addAssetGroup(stateInfo['assetGroupId'], userId)
	
	if stateId is not None: 	#If state name has changed, we need to check that it doesn't already exist
		currentStateId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('stateId', system.kanoa.asset.getStates({'stateName': stateInfo['stateName'], 'stateCategoryId' :stateInfo['stateCategoryId'], 'assetGroupId': stateInfo['assetGroupId']}))
		if currentStateId is not None and currentStateId != stateId:
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'This state already exists for this category'})
			return
		
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', {'message': 'Updating state Id %i '%stateId})			
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.asset.updateState(stateInfo, userId)
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showInfoToast', {'message': 'Adding state'})	
		stateId, msg = system.kanoa.asset.addState(stateInfo, userId)

	system.perspective.sendMessage("updateStates", {})

	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': "Couldn't save state. %s"%msg})
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'State has been saved.'})
		self.view.params.values.stateId = None
	
	return
